title: VAC Biometric Model Manifest (F-1202)
description: Describes one scoreable model/heuristic behind a biometric_harness stage adapter — either a real trained model (e.g. a future speaker-verification embedding model landing per vac-protocol/research/speaker-verification-eval's adapter pattern) or, as with today's reference adapter, a client-side heuristic gate wrapped in the same contract. adapter-interface.js refuses to construct an adapter for a manifest that fails this shape.

model_id.description: Stable identifier for the model/heuristic, e.g. 'vac-web:digit-voice-gate' or a future '@vladmandic/speaker-verify@1.0.0:ecapa-tdnn'.

version.description: Semver or source-anchored version string. For a heuristic (no model weights), the version of the GATE LOGIC it wraps.

stage.description: Which biometric_harness stage this manifest scores. 'speaker_verification' is reserved for the real speaker-embedding model tracked in vac-protocol/research/speaker-verification-eval; it does not exist in vac-web yet.

adapter.description: Module path (relative to tests/biometric_harness/adapters/) implementing the BiometricAdapter interface for this manifest.

source.description: Where this model/heuristic comes from, e.g. a file path + line range, or an external model registry URL.

thresholds.description: Stage-specific named thresholds this manifest asserts (mirrors, but does not replace, the source-anchored constants each stage module reads directly).

input_shape.description: Human-readable description of the expected fixture input shape for this stage, e.g. '[{tdBuf:Uint8Array(256), freqBuf:Uint8Array(128)}]' or '[float32 x 128]'.

created.description: YYYY-MM-DD this manifest was authored/last reviewed.
